get.description: List saved runs whose ontologies the policy permits; no pair data is loaded.
Batch display labels for typed entities in one ontology version.
Discover prepared explanations about an entity or an ordered/unordered entity pair.

AxiomInterpretation.title: AxiomInterpretation
AxiomInterpretation.description: Explicit assertion/derivation basis and frozen ontology scope.

AxiomOrigin.title: AxiomOrigin
AxiomOrigin.description: Exact native source occurrence, including an optional original source span.

AxiomRendering.title: AxiomRendering
AxiomRendering.description: A faithful display rendering may be incomplete without losing the original AST.

AxiomResponse.title: AxiomResponse
AxiomResponse.description: Original axiom identity, native structured form, rendering and visibility status.

Candidate.title: Candidate
Candidate.description: A typed candidate summary without graphs or an unqualified raw scorer payload.

EntityContextResponse.title: EntityContextResponse
EntityContextResponse.description: Independent summary with bounded original-fact categories.

EntityRef.title: EntityRef
EntityRef.description: An ontology-scoped typed entity; punning and duplicate labels remain distinct.

recorded_score.title: Recorded Score
recorded_score.description: Saved matcher comparison metric; not semantic equivalence or calibrated probability.

EvidenceBridge.title: EvidenceBridge
EvidenceBridge.description: Matcher comparison metadata, never an original ontology relationship.

EvidenceCounts.title: EvidenceCounts
EvidenceCounts.description: Available features refer to the declared cache scope, not ontology completeness.

ExactMatchBasis.title: ExactMatchBasis
ExactMatchBasis.description: Only an explicitly saved producer basis may have status recorded.

ExplanationSummary.title: ExplanationSummary
ExplanationSummary.description: Prepared text discovery without exposing or loading its claims into the response.

ExpressionTerm.title: ExpressionTerm
ExpressionTerm.description: A lossless structured expression loaded through explicit axiom detail.

Fact.title: Fact
Fact.description: Ontology fact with semantic identity and explicit interpretation basis.

FactPacket.title: FactPacket
FactPacket.description: Candidate-blind entity input, or score-blind pair input with frozen profile dependencies.

FeatureDerivation.title: FeatureDerivation
FeatureDerivation.description: Projection rules remain distinct from the original asserted ontology facts.

GeneratedExplanationResponse.title: GeneratedExplanationResponse
GeneratedExplanationResponse.description: Prepared generated artifact, with grounding and generation failure represented separately.

GenerationManifest.title: GenerationManifest
GenerationManifest.description: Frozen generation dependencies and actual provider identity, excluding secrets.

Health.title: Health
Health.description: Public service readiness without filesystem or credential metadata.

Label.title: Label
Label.description: Display text never replaces an entity's typed identity.

LabelLookup.title: LabelLookup
LabelLookup.description: One typed label result; undeclared IRIs retain their requested identity.

LabelsResponse.title: LabelsResponse
LabelsResponse.description: Bounded batch lookup; punning may produce multiple typed results per IRI.

LiteralTerm.title: LiteralTerm
LiteralTerm.description: Lossless literal identity, including lexical spelling, datatype and language.

MembershipProvenance.title: MembershipProvenance
MembershipProvenance.description: Final membership is supported by the saved alignment, never a score threshold.

OrdinalRanks.title: OrdinalRanks
OrdinalRanks.description: Ordinals are separate from scores and retain their ordering/tie provenance.

Origin.title: Origin
Origin.description: Original asserted axiom provenance, distinct from interpretation rules.

OwlExpression.title: OwlExpression
OwlExpression.description: Typed OWL constructor; constructor-specific fields remain lossless additive JSON.

PairResponse.title: PairResponse
PairResponse.description: Immutable pair binding, original decisions and actual persisted membership.

PreferredLabel.title: PreferredLabel
PreferredLabel.description: Policy-visible display label or an explicit scoped absence.

RecordedComparisonResolution.title: RecordedComparisonResolution
RecordedComparisonResolution.description: A saved comparison's identity resolution, without exposing raw legacy aliases.

RunSummary.title: RunSummary
RunSummary.description: Saved run discovery metadata; pair records and graphs remain unloaded.

Scope.title: Scope
Scope.description: The complete semantic scope to which a collection cursor is bound.

Score.title: Score
Score.description: A recorded value with stage semantics, never an implied calibrated probability.

SelectedEvidence.title: SelectedEvidence
SelectedEvidence.description: A selected matcher feature and its many-to-many links to original ontology facts.

SourceCandidateRecord.title: SourceCandidateRecord
SourceCandidateRecord.description: Exact saved array location and scores; this position is not an ordinal rank.

StageEvent.title: StageEvent
StageEvent.description: Bounded finite pipeline event with recorded or explicitly absent stage evidence.

VisibleEvidenceCounts.title: VisibleEvidenceCounts
VisibleEvidenceCounts.description: Physical policy export reveals only its visible evidence count.
